subject: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning
overview: The board voted to recommend approval of the Salem Street corridor zoning amendments to the City Council after incorporating revisions based on extensive public feedback. The board also approved covenant releases and a roadway extension for the Mary Kenny Way subdivision and entered an executive session to discuss pending litigation.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The board voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy for the Massachusetts Land Court case, New York Capital Investment Group, LLC, versus the City of Medford Community Development Board.

items.title: Mary Kenny Way Subdivision Requests
items.summary: The board approved the release of covenants for lots 1 through 4, accepted a cash security agreement, granted an 18-month extension for roadway completion, and authorized Director Alicia Hunt to sign the paperwork.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Following a public hearing with substantial community testimony, the board voted to recommend approval of the draft zoning amendments to the City Council, with additional recommendations to align residential parcels with the Urban Residential 1 district and to adjust height incentive parameters for concealed parking, plazas, and fountains.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board voted to approve the meeting minutes from January 15, 2025, and February 5, 2025.

items.title: Zoning Updates
items.summary: Staff provided brief updates on the status of citywide residential zoning and upcoming minor changes to the MBTA communities zoning.
